rationale: TNON has traded roughly 85x its entire float today with no identifiable news catalyst, making price action driven entirely by speculation/momentum with no fundamental anchor for sizing risk. The most recent high-volume candle (281k) produced a wick to $5.40 and closed at $5.24, suggesting upside rejection, but with 36 minutes to close on a micro-cap this prone to halts and erratic prints, neither a long continuation nor a short fade offers a manageable risk/reward — the bid/ask spread and halt risk make stop placement unreliable. With the daily budget already positive and no structural edge identifiable, capital preservation is the correct posture.
